newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: SOCCER-IRELAND V LIECHTENSTEIN TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-IRELAND V LIECHTENSTEIN TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for the World Cup European group eight qualifier between Ireland and Liechtenstein on Wednesday:
Ireland - 1-Shay Given; 2-Jeff Kenna, 4-Ian Harte, 5-Ken Cunningham, 3-Steve Staunton; 10-Gary Kelly, 8-Ray Houghton, 6- Roy Keane, 7-Andy Townsend (captain), 11-Mark Kennedy; 9-David Connolly.

Liechtenstein - 1-Martin Heeb; 2-Thomas Hanselmann, 5-Martin Stocklasa, 3-Patrick Hefti; 7-Daniel Telser, 9-Christoph Frick, 10-Peter Klaunzer, 6-Daniel Helser, 8-Mario Frick (captain), 4- Franz Schadler; 11-Daniel Frick.
